trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: it is awarded automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned.
trophies.guide: The platinum itself. It pops on its own the moment the other 54 trophies on this list are all earned, so there is nothing separate to hunt: work the roadmap stages in order, keep the missable watch-list in view, and this lands last. Sources: official name, description and grade from the PlayStation list [1][2]; roadmap framing from [3][6].

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.missableNote: Story trophy from the opening mission; it cannot be skipped.
trophies.guide: Start a new game and play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, through to the mission-complete screen. Follow the on-screen objectives and treat it as your tutorial for driving, cover and switching between the two leads. The trophy is awarded automatically as the mission ends. Sources: official description [1][2]; opening-mission framing from [3].

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.missableNote: Chapter completion is automatic as the story advances.
trophies.guide: Finish every main mission of Chapter 1 and the trophy unlocks when the chapter closes. Nothing in the chapter can be skipped, so just keep following the story markers. Before you move on, note that meditation spots begin appearing during this chapter, which matters for Positive Mental Attitude later. Sources: official description [1][2]; chapter structure from [3][4].

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.missableNote: Chapter completion is automatic as the story advances.
trophies.guide: Complete all of Chapter 2's main missions. The name is shown exactly as PlayStation publishes it, asterisks included. Keep progressing the story and the trophy arrives with the chapter's final mission. Sources: official name and description [1][2]; roadmap order from [3].

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.missableNote: Chapter completion is automatic as the story advances.
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 3 to its end. By now the map and activity types are opening up, so it is a good point to start sampling one of each activity for Master of None alongside the story. The trophy itself needs nothing beyond finishing the chapter. Sources: official description [1][2]; activity framing from [5].

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.missableNote: Chapter completion is automatic as the story advances.
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4's main missions. After this chapter only the finale remains, so clear any stranger strands you have open before pushing into the endgame, while every contact is still available. Sources: official description [1][2]; strand timing advice from [3][4].

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.missableNote: The final mission is unmissable; free roam continues afterwards for cleanup.
trophies.guide: Complete the story's final mission. This gold trophy is awarded at the end of the campaign, and the open world remains available afterwards, so almost everything else on the list can still be cleaned up in free roam. Sources: official description and grade [1][2]; post-story cleanup framing from [3][6].

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.missableNote: Named story mission; awarded on completion.
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Breakfast Run when it appears on the map. Follow its objective chain to the end and the trophy unlocks at the mission summary. Sources: official description [1][2].

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.missableNote: Named story mission; awarded on completion.
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist, one of the campaign's set-piece missions. Prepare a clean getaway vehicle before the finale of the job and the trophy lands when the heist wraps up. Sources: official description [1][2]; heist preparation advice from [3].

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.missableNote: Named story mission; awarded on completion.
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Child's Play. It is part of the main campaign path, so simply reach it and complete its objectives. Sources: official description [1][2].

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.missableNote: Named story mission; awarded on completion.
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Follow the mission marker when it unlocks and play it through; the trophy is automatic at the end. Sources: official description [1][2].

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.missableNote: Named story mission; awarded on completion. Note the airport also hosts Catch Me If You Can.
trophies.guide: Finish VCIA Takedown, the airport-centred story mission. While you are at VCIA, remember the separate feat trophy Catch Me If You Can is also tied to this location, though it can be done in free roam. Sources: official description [1][2]; location cross-reference from the official descriptions [1].

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.missableNote: Named story mission; awarded on completion.
trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory when it becomes available in the campaign. Stock up on armour and snacks beforehand, as set-piece missions tend to run long, and the trophy unlocks at mission end. Sources: official description [1][2].

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.missableNote: Nothing on the 100% checklist is permanently missable, but stranger strands should be finished before the finale to be safe.
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist: story, stranger strands, activities, collectibles and exploration all feed it. Use the game's own checklist as the authority and mop up category by category after the story; most other trophies on this list are earned along the way. Sources: official description [1][2]; 100% checklist composition from [4][6].

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.missableNote: Stunt jumps stay available in free roam; repeatable at any time.
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunt jumps scattered across Leonida. Work region by region in free roam, using a fast bike or sports car, and keep a manual tally beside PlayStation's tracked count of 250. There is no deadline, so leave the bulk of these for the post-story cleanup. Sources: official description and tracked count [1][2]; stunt total framing from [5].

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.missableNote: Every activity type remains available after the story.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types at least once: races, shooting range, fishing, drone races, arcade games, bowling, meditation and the rest as they unlock. You only need to sample each type, not master it, so do this early to learn which activities the grind trophies will ask more of. Sources: official description and count [1][2]; activity list framing from [5].

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.missableNote: Range challenges are repeatable without limit.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Practise each weapon class until its accuracy and time targets feel routine, replay freely, and save the hardest golds for after you have upgraded weapons through the story. PlayStation tracks the 42 challenges, so the counter tells you exactly what remains. Sources: official description and count [1][2]; method framing from [3].

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.missableNote: Drone race locations stay open in free roam.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Learn each course with one slow sighting run, then push for the win; a victory at every location is required, not just participation. Sources: official description and count [1][2].

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.missableNote: Races are repeatable; 20 different ones must be won.
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — repeats of the same race do not add to the count. Bring a tuned vehicle suited to each class, and work through the race map methodically so you do not waste time re-winning ones already banked. Sources: official description and count [1][2].

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.missableNote: The fishing challenge can be retried.
trophies.guide: Enter Cal's fishing challenge and out-catch him before the timer ends. Learn the casting and reeling rhythm in free fishing first, then challenge him when the mechanic feels natural. Losing costs nothing but time — simply challenge him again. Sources: official description [1][2].

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.missableNote: Arcade cabinets remain playable at any time.
trophies.guide: Find any arcade cabinet in the world and play one full arcade game to completion. Pick the shortest cabinet game you find; the trophy only asks for one finished game, not a high score. Sources: official description [1][2].

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.missableNote: Watch tier: stranger strands are best finished before the final story missions, in case a contact becomes unavailable.
trophies.guide: Work Andy's stranger strand from its first marker to his final mission. Because strand contacts are safest cleared before the endgame, do not leave Andy's last job until after the finale. Sources: official description [1][2]; strand timing from [3][4].

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.missableNote: Watch tier: finish Kenton's strand before the final story missions to be safe.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's strand of stranger missions through to his final one. Start it when his marker appears and finish the chain in the same chapter block where possible. Sources: official description [1][2]; strand timing from [3][4].

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.missableNote: Watch tier: finish Billy's strand before the final story missions to be safe.
trophies.guide: Play Billy's stranger strand to its final mission. Keep his chain moving whenever you are in his part of the map, and close it out before the endgame. Sources: official description [1][2]; strand timing from [3][4].

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: Watch tier: you need 8 full strands; start them as they appear so none is left dependent on late-game availability.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full stranger mission strands anywhere in Leonida. The named trophies for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone each count as one strand, so those five plus any three others complete the set. Finish strands rather than starting many and abandoning them. Sources: official description and count [1][2]; strand composition from [4].

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.missableNote: Watch tier: finish Randy's strand before the final story missions to be safe.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's stranger strand through his final mission. Pick the chain up when his marker appears and see it through before the campaign's last stretch. Sources: official description [1][2]; strand timing from [3][4].

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.missableNote: Watch tier: finish Tyrone's strand before the final story missions to be safe.
trophies.guide: Play Tyrone's stranger missions to the final one. As with the other named strands, the safe pattern is to finish it in the chapter range where it opens rather than banking it for post-game. Sources: official description [1][2]; strand timing from [3][4].

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: Possible tier: guides warn that a Chapter 1 meditation spot can be passed during the story, so meditate at every spot the moment you find one.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. The honest warning first: published roadmap advice flags an early spot reachable during Chapter 1 that is easy to walk past, so never defer a spot — sit down the moment you find one, and sweep the remaining spots region by region after the story. Sources: official description and count [1][2]; Chapter 1 warning from [3].

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.missableNote: Watch tier: Bret is a strand contact; complete his hunt before the endgame.
trophies.guide: Take Bret's hunting job and bring down the unique animal he sends you after. Track it in the rural part of the map, approach downwind and patiently, and finish the hunt as part of his strand rather than leaving it open. Sources: official description [1][2]; strand timing from [3][4].

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.missableNote: Cards stay where they spawn; sets can be completed at any time.
trophies.guide: Finish 3 complete Collectible Card sets. Pick the three smallest sets first, sweep them area by area, and tick cards off as you go so the last few stragglers are easy to identify. This is a cleanup-phase trophy once the map is fully open. Sources: official description and count [1][2].

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.missableNote: Locations remain available; a long free-roam grind with no deadline.
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK interaction at 100 different locations. Treat it as a map-completion sweep: clear one district fully before moving to the next, and let PlayStation's tracked count of 100 confirm your progress rather than guessing. Sources: official description and count [1][2].

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.missableNote: Challenges can be attempted throughout and after the story.
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 challenges from the game's challenge lists. Mix quick activity challenges with feat-style ones as you play naturally, then top up the count in cleanup with whichever challenges are closest to done. Sources: official description and count [1][2].

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.missableNote: Repeatable in free roam with your partner at any time.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, raise a 4-star wanted level, then break line of sight and hide until the stars drain away. A fast car, a quick change of vehicle and alleys or parking structures away from the search zone make this straightforward in free roam. Sources: official description [1][2].

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.missableNote: Repeatable: plan a route of three close shops before starting.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in a row while keeping a wanted level the whole time — losing the stars between shops breaks the chain. Scout three nearby stores first, keep moving between them, and only shake the heat after the third till is empty. Sources: official description and count [1][2].

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.missableNote: Vehicles keep spawning in traffic; discovery accumulates naturally.
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles by getting in or registering them as you encounter them. Most of the count arrives naturally through the story; in cleanup, vary your districts and vehicle classes — docks, airports and rich neighbourhoods spawn different traffic. Sources: official description and count [1][2].

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.missableNote: Repeatable in any crowded firefight.
trophies.guide: Trigger Combat Focus once in a fight with at least five enemies in view and drop all five before the effect ends. Gang hideouts and illegal operations give you grouped targets; line the shots up before activating so the slow window is spent firing, not searching. Sources: official description and count [1][2].

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.missableNote: Repeatable at the airport in free roam.
trophies.guide: At VCIA, the airport, leave in an unscheduled way — in practice, take an aircraft or vehicle out of the airport outside any mission or booked departure. Head to the airfield in free roam, commandeer something that flies or drives off the grounds, and the trophy should pop as you depart. Sources: official description [1][2]; interpretation is our own reading of the official wording, flagged as unconfirmed until checked in game.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.missableNote: Repeatable whenever military hardware appears at high wanted levels.
trophies.guide: The cryptic official line points at Rhinos, the game's tanks. Raise a high wanted level until Rhinos deploy, then engage one — surviving the encounter and dealing with the tank is the feat. Bring heavy weapons and a repair route, and try it in free roam rather than mid-mission. Sources: official description [1][2]; reading of the hint is our own inference from the official text, not yet verified in game.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.missableNote: Repeatable; a failed attempt only means trying the next store quietly.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being spotted: enter quietly, keep the staff controlled without raising an alarm, empty the cases and leave before anyone reports you. Go in at a quiet hour, avoid cameras and witnesses, and have the getaway car parked out of sight. Sources: official description [1][2].

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.missableNote: Bank vaults can be robbed repeatedly across the map.
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape the police each time. Treat each vault as a mini-heist: crew the entry, grab the vault cash fast, and pre-plan the escape route and vehicle swap. Five separate successful escapes are needed. Sources: official description and count [1][2].

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.missableNote: Armored trucks appear in free roam traffic.
trophies.guide: Find an armored truck in free roam, stop it, crack the rear doors open, take the cash and escape the resulting wanted level. Heavy firepower or explosives open the doors fastest; grab the money before reinforcements stack up. Sources: official description [1][2].

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.missableNote: Exploration never locks; unfog the whole map at your own pace.
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida so no part of the map stays blank. Drive or fly the borders of each region, and use the remaining fog on your map as the checklist — coastal keys and rural corners are the usual leftovers. Sources: official description and count [1][2].

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.missableNote: One operation per gang; all nine gangs keep operations in free roam.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Note which gang owns each site as you clear it — nine different gangs are required, not nine robberies of the same crew. These raids also make good Combat Focus practice for Gunslinger. Sources: official description and count [1][2].

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.missableNote: Repeatable at Ocean Beach at any time.
trophies.guide: Go to Ocean Beach, buy or order a cocktail at a beachfront spot and drink it while taking in the view. It is a quiet moment trophy: be at the location, use the drink interaction, and let the scene play. The name is shown with its ellipsis exactly as PlayStation publishes it. Sources: official description [1][2].

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.missableNote: Repeatable at any vehicle showroom with a glass front.
trophies.guide: Get inside a vehicle showroom, take one of its cars and drive straight out through the showroom glass. Pick a showroom with display cars near the window line, and make the exit in the car rather than on foot. Sources: official description [1][2]; the method is our own reading of the official wording.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.missableNote: The bowling alley stays open; shown with the curly apostrophe as published.
trophies.guide: Visit the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl with a proper follow-through — in practice, play a game or take your shot at the lanes there. It also counts as sampling the bowling activity type for Master of None. Sources: official description [1][2].

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.missableNote: A deliberately cryptic hidden trophy; tied to the partner system, repeatable in free roam.
trophies.guide: The official description is deliberately vague — a partnership moment with mass appeal. Our honest reading: it involves the two leads acting together in public view, so try partner activities and joint feats around crowds. We flag this guide as interpretive: the official text is all anyone can cite until players confirm the trigger. Sources: official description [1][2]; interpretation clearly marked as our own.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.missableNote: PlayStation tracks a count of 500; choices accumulate across the whole playthrough.
trophies.guide: Make choices until PlayStation's tracked count reaches 500. Dialogue and world choices throughout the story and side content feed this counter, so engage with optional conversations instead of skipping them; the remainder can be ground out with repeatable choice interactions in cleanup. Sources: official description and tracked count of 500 [1][2].

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.missableNote: Cryptic hidden trophy; retry-based feats are repeatable by nature.
trophies.guide: Another deliberately cryptic line: succeed at something on the second attempt after failing it once. Our reading is to fail and then immediately retry an activity or challenge and pass it. We mark this as interpretation of the official wording only — no source pins the exact trigger yet. Sources: official description [1][2]; interpretation is our own, stated honestly.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.missableNote: A strange-event trophy; such encounters are typically repeatable world events.
trophies.guide: Witness one of Leonida's strange, unexplained events — the kind the description reacts to. Explore remote spots at night, including swamps and the keys, and investigate odd lights or encounters rather than driving past. The exact event list is unconfirmed, so this guide stays honest: it is built from the official description alone. Sources: official description [1][2].

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.missableNote: Repeatable in traffic whenever pedestrians are in reach.
trophies.guide: From a moving vehicle, knock a pedestrian down with a melee swing out of the window — the drive-by melee. Ride as passenger or slow-roll past a pavement crowd and time the swing as you pass. It takes a few attempts to learn the range. Sources: official description [1][2].

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.missableNote: Laundering stays available through your contacts after the story.
trophies.guide: Launder marked bills through your contacts until $250,000 has been earned. Robberies and operations supply marked bills; run them through the laundering contact regularly instead of sitting on them, and the total builds alongside your other crime trophies. Sources: official description and amount [1][2].

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.missableNote: Spending is cumulative across every shop; no deadline.
trophies.guide: Spend a cumulative $100,000 across all shops: vehicles, weapons, clothes, garages and services all count. Never sell yourself short on upgrades and this arrives naturally late in a 100% run; if it lags, vehicle and property purchases close the gap fastest. Sources: official description and amount [1][2].

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.missableNote: All 8 garages stay on sale; save income from heists and laundering.
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties across Leonida. Save earnings from heists, vault robberies and laundering instead of spending them early, then buy the garages district by district — they also give your discovered vehicles somewhere to live. Sources: official description and count [1][2].

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.missableNote: Any 10 vehicles can be registered at any time.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app: whenever you take a vehicle you like, use the app registration before moving on. Ten registrations is a small count that most players finish during the story without trying. Sources: official description and count [1][2].
